entities.name: Reyhan, Last of the Abzan
entities.description: Legendary human warrior of Tarkir, joint commander of three Abzan Houses and the clan's final khan.

entities.name: Daghatar
entities.description: Khan of the Abzan who surrendered to Dromoka.

entities.name: Shu Yun
entities.description: Summoned Reyhan to a summit of the khans.

entities.name: Felothar
entities.description: Reyhan's descendant, khan of the reforged Abzan.

events.summary: Reyhan is shocked when Daghatar, the Abzan khan, surrenders to the Dragonlord.
events.quote: she was shocked when the khan of the Abzan, Daghatar , surrendered to the Dragonlord

events.summary: Reyhan refuses to kneel to a dragon and rallies the remnants of her clan, becoming its final khan.
events.quote: Reyhan refused to kneel to a dragon

events.summary: During the Khanfall of Tarkir, Reyhan is felled by Silumgar while protecting Yasova Dragonclaw and Alesha.
events.quote: Reyhan was felled by Silumgar himself

relations.quote: Reyhan was felled by Silumgar himself
